source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Boot into OS and load driver, stress the module
2. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist to check the sensor will change

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Power sensor should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.
3. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.

original_test_intent: Exercise the system under an approved load and verify the power readings and protection behavior for each of PSU1 through PSU6.
original_method: Apply a host/module workload and collect six PSU power sensors plus SEL through BMC/IPMI.
manual_activity: Engineer confirms six-PSU topology, feeds and safe load distribution; automation can execute the approved load and collect each PSU channel.
required_inputs: Approved workload and per-feed/total power envelope
Expected sharing, redundancy, thresholds and recovery
safety_requirements: Verify redundancy, AC feeds and load headroom before stress.
Monitor all six PSUs, input/output power, temperature and host health.
Stop on imbalance, derating, redundancy loss or fault; no automatic retry.
Preserve raw evidence and return to stable load.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, automate baseline/load/recovery and correlate each PSU with total load, sharing, SEL and health.
Do not manipulate AC feeds or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve topology, load distribution and safety/recovery.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Outline is relevant but lacks six-slot mapping, load distribution and measured redundancy evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use documented per-PSU telemetry plus independent system/feed power measurements.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PSU1-PSU6, stress/IPMI method, script and 5/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Baseline all six PSUs, apply approved load steps, measure per-slot sharing and feed redundancy, correlate SEL/protection, then verify recovery.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor PSU PMBus, sharing and derating specifications.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds slot/feed identity and sharing evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents aggregate power from masking an idle, imbalanced or failed PSU.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Topology, read contract and load budget.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: System load can derate or trip a PSU/feed.

project_override_considerations: If a project has fewer fitted PSUs, record that topology and do not claim six-slot coverage; record approved load/duration overrides.
expected_evidence: Total/feed load, sharing, SEL and thermal timeline
